footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $6.2M income tax benefit. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $20.1M from $12.4M.
The net loss widened to $35.9M, or −$1.12 per share, from $12.2M. Operating cash flow was −$16.1M and free cash flow −$16.1M, versus −$10.9M.
sources: Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
